run_ddp_training: run the distributed data parallel training loop for contrastive scene contexts using Hydra config
run_single_proc_training: run a single process training or test loop with a data loader and trainer
get_trainer_by_name: get a trainer class by name such as PointNCELossTrainer or PartitionPointNCELossTrainer
run_multi_gpu_training: run multi-GPU training using multiprocessing with the specified number of GPUs
test_contrastive_model: run the test evaluation loop for a contrastive scene contexts model
